purpose: Test whether two physically distinct charge-generation routes can improve retention of useful generation under a perturbation that damages one route more strongly than the other. This is a resilience model, not evidence that D18/PY-IT/eC9 already has a large donor-independent current fraction.

sources.citation: Hart et al., Molecular factors controlling charge pair generation in organic photovoltaic materials, Nature Materials 25, 1209-1218 (2026)
used_for: importance of reorganization energy, electronic coupling, disorder, packing, and state delocalization
caution that single-domain charge generation is unlikely to dominate photocurrent in low-offset heterojunctions

sources.citation: Ivanovic et al., Transiently delocalised hybrid quantum states are gateways for efficient exciton dissociation at organic donor-acceptor interfaces, Nature Communications 16, 11560 (2025)
used_for: transient hybrid exciton-CT states can enable charge separation away from a nominal interface in a model heterojunction
electronic coupling and dielectric screening as independent drivers
interfacial disorder can suppress the hot pathway

sources.citation: Cui et al., Non-Fullerene Acceptor Photo-Charge Enabled Stretchable Photovoltaic Robustness Under 90% Tensile Strain and 30% Strain Cycles, Advanced Materials 38, e73632 (2026)
used_for: experimental precedent that bulk NFA photogeneration can be used to reduce morphology sensitivity under mechanical deformation
reported >80% initial-PCE retention at 90% tensile strain and after 1000 cycles at 30% strain in the cited stretchable system

definitions.G_I0: baseline contribution from an interface-sensitive generation route
definitions.G_B0: baseline contribution from a more distributed/bulk-like generation route
definitions.f_B: G_B0 / (G_I0 + G_B0), dimensionless baseline fractional contribution
definitions.r_I: retention factor of interface route after perturbation, dimensionless
definitions.r_B: retention factor of bulk/distributed route after perturbation, dimensionless
definitions.R: total generation retention after perturbation, dimensionless

equations.inverse: f_B = (R-r_I)/(r_B-r_I), valid only when independently justified r_B>r_I and R is bracketed by r_I and r_B

synthetic_fixture.classification: software-test assumptions only; not physical thresholds or expected D18/PY-IT/eC9 behavior

prospective_hypothesis.statement: A process/material state that creates a secondary generation route with a different perturbation sensitivity can improve retention of charge generation/useful work under morphology or interface disruption, even if that route is not the dominant nominal photocurrent pathway.
prospective_hypothesis.target_program_interpretation: For D18/PY-IT/eC9, any claim of mechanism redundancy requires v3.70-style donor-free controls plus matched stressed/unstressed B0/B1/B2 measurements. A donor-free effect alone is not proof that it contributes materially to heterojunction current.
falsifiers: The putative bulk/distributed route is not measurably more perturbation-robust than the interface-sensitive route.
Any apparent retention advantage disappears after optical absorption, contact/transport, active-area, or morphology normalization.
Absolute stabilized Pmax is worse despite better normalized retention.
Donor-free controls show no corresponding intrinsic generation capability while the heterojunction effect is fully explained by ordinary interface/contact changes.

required_outputs: stabilized Pmax before and after perturbation
field-dependent generation discriminator such as TDCF or bias-dependent PL/IQE
donor-free A0/A1/A2 control where physically valid
measurement_policy.note: No physical threshold is frozen from the synthetic model or cross-material literature.

validity_limits: The two-route decomposition is phenomenological and need not map uniquely onto microscopic states.
Parallel contributions may interact nonlinearly through recombination, transport, state filling, or field redistribution; the linear model is a first falsification baseline only.
Normalized retention cannot substitute for absolute useful-work performance.
The stretchable AQx-2F system is not D18/PY-IT/eC9 and its strain robustness cannot be transferred quantitatively.
Hart et al. explicitly caution that single-domain generation is unlikely to dominate nominal photocurrent in low-offset heterojunctions.
No quantum advantage or commercial performance claim follows from route redundancy alone.
